motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Repealing and Reenacting Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 2.45 Youth Council
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Repealing and Reenacting Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 2.45 Youth Council with changes as follows: • Include “Youth” Mayor when referring to the Youth Mayor and “Mayor” when referring to the appointed City Mayor, • In Section 2.45.040 Subsection E, committee approval by the City Manager will be replaced by Youth Council Committee of Advisors. • In Section 2.45.040 Subsection A.8., include “Elected City Mayor” when coordinating all activities with the Youth Council Committee of Advisors. • In 2.45.010 Section C: Change from “members are appointed to Youth Council by the City Manager” to “members are appointed by the Youth Council Committee of Advisors”. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Disposal of 0.156 Acres of Designated "Significant Real Property" (Utah County Parcel #49:601:0080) Pursuant to EMMC 3.30.060 and 3.30.070, and Establishing Terms of the Disposal
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Disposal of 0.156 Acres of Designated "Significant Real Property" (Utah County Parcel #49:601:0080) Pursuant to EMMC 3.30.060 and 3.30.070, and Establishing Terms of the Disposal with terms below: • Approving option two with each landowner of the parcels listed signing the land disposal application. The applicants may combine the application into one land disposal application and fee. • If any landowner, in any of the lots are unwilling or unable to purchase the corresponding parcels, the approval will revert to option one. • It is required that all fences are on the correct lot line or the lots are to have no fence within 6 months of recordation. • The water requirements for each parcel are fulfilled with the purchase of the parcels as deemed appropriate by staff. • The full land disposal application and process must be finalized in six months (February 19, 2026). Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Providing for a Referendum to be held on November 4, 2025, for the purpose of submitting to the qualified voters of Eagle Mountain City, Utah County, Utah the question of authorization of the imposition a 0.1% sales and use tax (one-tenth of one percent) for the purpose of funding recreational, cultural, botanical, and zoological facilities, and botanical, cultural, and zoological organizations within the City (RAP Tax)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Providing for a Referendum to be held on November 4, 2025, for the purpose of submitting to the qualified voters of Eagle Mountain City, Utah County, Utah the question of authorization of the imposition a 0.1% sales and use tax (one-tenth of one percent) for the purpose of funding recreational, cultural, botanical, and zoological facilities, and botanical, cultural, and zoological organizations within the City (RAP Tax). Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
